facts.business: GTL Infrastructure Limited is an IP-1 registered entity engaged in providing passive telecom infrastructure on a shared basis to mobile telecommunications service providers for hosting active network equipment.

auditor.name: M/s. C.V.K & Associates / CVK & Associates

key_risks: Unauthorized dismantling/theft of unoccupied sites (362 sites dismantled in FY 2025-26)
Substantial costs and liabilities on unoccupied towers without revenue
Landowner legal actions and blocked site access
Non-receipt of rental amounts from operators
Going concern uncertainty dependent on debt resolution and sector recovery
